speaker: customer
text: No claims. Not one. And my premium goes UP? This is cheating!

speaker: agent
text: You are right to be angry — and after this many years with us, you deserve a straight answer, not a script.

speaker: agent
text: Two things moved: the government revised third-party rates, and your car’s parts got costlier to repair. Neither is about your driving — your record actually earned a discount that is already applied.

speaker: customer
text: So without my record it would be even worse?

speaker: agent
text: Noticeably. And if you want, I will go line by line so you can see exactly what you are paying for.
